notes: Antagonist pole implies opposition/wrongdoing; protagonist often implies moral heroism; general good vs. bad framing.
Devoted maps to loyalty/ingroup virtue; unfaithful maps to authority vice and ingroup vice in the dictionary.
Fearmongering causes harm/distress; reassuring relates to care and protection of others.
Genocidal pole involves extreme harm, injustice, group destruction, and oppression; touches multiple foundations.
White knight pole implies protection/care and moral virtue; bad boy implies rule-breaking and impurity; general moral contrast.
Both poles relate to hierarchical status/authority roles.
Yes-man relates to submission/compliance (authority); contrarian relates to defiance/dissent (liberty/authority vice).
Giving relates to care/nurturance; the contrast also evokes reciprocity and fairness.
Frankness relates to honesty, which maps to fairness virtue in the dictionary.
